item.title: A40 overnight roadworks diversion through village, 7th August
item.description:
From A40 through Shipton oliffe in both directions. Cars and lorries drive through village all night. Damage to infrastructure, weak bridges, fencing, narrow lanes, damage to cars and vehicle debris through village, damage to trees and verges. Lorries getting stuck in narrow lanes waling up households to move cars at 4am because lorry ignored signage. Suggest A40 closed from Pike House turning so traffic can proceed along this road rather than A40 junction with Bees Lane. Suggest roadwork employees actually stop traffic from coming into village
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Shipton, Cotswold

item.title: Flytipping, 6th August
item.description:
About half way along the woodland walk on the east side of the Agg Gardner playing field. In the undergrowth, by the school railings is a gas boiler. Nearby, on the path, is a circulating pump. Both presumably dumped by an irresponsible heating fitter. On the bench, near the southern end of the path, is some scrap iron and an HV cable jointing box.
